mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') as holdDate, MDATE as busiMDate, IFNULL(BALANCE_AMT,0) as prdBalanceAmt, IFNULL(PRD_QTY,0) as prdTotalQty, IFNULL(TOTAL_AMT,0) as prdRaiseTotalAmt, IFNULL(RAISE_QTY,0) as prdRaiseTotalQty, IFNULL(SUM(CNY_AMT),0) as investBalanceAmt, IFNULL(SUM(QTY),0) as investTotalQty, REG_CODE as prdRegistCode FROM ( SELECT tmp1.PROD_ID, tmp1.MDATE, tmp1.BALANCE_AMT, tmp1.PRD_QTY, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT, tmp1.RAISE_QTY, CASE WHEN C.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE C.CNY_AMT END CNY_AMT, CASE WHEN C.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE C.QTY END QTY, D.REG_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by tmp1.PROD_ID, tmp1.MDATE, C.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY C.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) AS hodeStsNo FROM( SELECT PROD_ID, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY FROM( SELECT A.PROD_ID, A.MDATE, A.BALANCE_AMT, A.PRD_QTY, B.TOTAL_AMT, B.RAISE_QTY, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by A.PROD_ID , A.MDATE ORDER BY B.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) AS raiseStatusNo FROM objRec A INNER JOIN CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PROD_ID ) WHERE raiseStatusNo = 1 ) tmp1 LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE D ON tmp1.PROD_ID = D.PRODID LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB C ON tmp1.PROD_ID = C.PRODID WHERE STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(C.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) WHERE hodeStsNo = 1 GROUP BY PROD_ID, REG_CODE, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY
